'''Bea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. There she worked as a receptionist in [[Figg Hall]], a public space in the city's [[Tourist District]] for residents or visitors to speak to representatives of the [[City/Legends|city]]. As such, she could arrange meetings with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the city, or [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], Calrissian's chief administrative aid. Bea worked alongside the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[B-7G]], and was polite and efficient while at work. A pretty woman, she could be charmed into showing the city's official records, but would alert Lobot to individuals of interest viewing such material.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bea first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. Bea is listed as a character that players might interact with to look up official files on other characters in the adventure, but as her involvement is completely optional this article does not assume such a meeting took place.
